description: Materialize selected PDF or text documents into an isolated batch and rebuild the configured model training and validation datasets before training.

configPath.description: Absolute or project-relative training TOML whose data outputs are rebuilt. The runtime normalizes it to an absolute path.
configPath.name: configPath

documentPaths.description: Absolute document paths or file:// URIs selected for this training objective. Each item is materialized; all items are then prepared as one batch.
documentPaths.name: documentPaths

datasetPolicy.description: Deterministic deduplication, balancing, coverage and validation-independence report.
datasetPolicy.name: datasetPolicy

sourcePlan.description: Structured, generic contract containing mandatory requiredSubjects and fully covering sources with exact paths, required subject labels and evidence. Conditional discovery subjects are reported separately and never gate preparation. Evidence may be a non-empty string or a list of non-empty strings and is normalized deterministically.
sourcePlan.name: sourcePlan

textOutputDir.description: Project-relative parent directory for isolated per-run text batches.
textOutputDir.name: textOutputDir

name: finetune_prepare_documents

includedFiles.description: Number of files included by the generated manifest.
includedFiles.name: includedFiles

materializedPaths.description: Text files produced or copied for dataset preparation.
materializedPaths.name: materializedPaths

policyPass.description: Whether every required subject is covered by independent train and validation records.
policyPass.name: policyPass

policyPath.description: Absolute path to the generated source-to-subject policy contract stored outside the document input directory.
policyPath.name: policyPath

sourceCoverage.description: Whether the generated manifest includes exactly one materialized file for every selected source.
sourceCoverage.name: sourceCoverage

stagingDirectory.description: Isolated project-relative materialization directory for this batch.
stagingDirectory.name: stagingDirectory

success.description: Whether materialization and preparation succeeded with exact source coverage and non-zero train and validation records.
success.name: success
